NCURA's Commitment to You:

We want to offer you: cutting-edge programs that meet your needs; know what volunteer opportunities you want; and enhance your professional network. Please take a moment to update your membership profile here.

CHECK PAYMENT: Register by check using the online Check Registration Form: Region 6 & 7 Check Registration Form Make checks payable to NCURA Region VI. Mail check payment along with a hard copy of the Check Registration Form information sent to registrant's email to:

National Council of University Research Adminstrators PO Box 98396 Washington, DC 20090-8300

Check registration inquiries should be directed to: info@ncura.edu For Form W-9 at your institution: NCURA Federal I.D. #52-1721115

Dietary need requests should be directed to: Megan Dietrich, reymar@stanford.edu. Accessibility requests should be directed to: Lori Shuler lfergus8@uwyo.edu or Garrett Steed garrett.steed@cuanschutz.edu

More Location Information: The $229/night rate is honored 3 days before and 3 days after the meeting. Hotel Booking Link

Overnight self-parking is at a reduced rate of $25/night. Daily discounted self-parking for non-overnight guests is reduced to $12/day.

NCURA  REGIONAL MEETING AND WORKSHOP CANCELLATION & SUBSTITUTIONS POLICY: The cancellation deadline is September 30, 2026. An administrative fee of $75 will be assessed on meeting registration cancellations and an additional $25 per workshop. Cancellations and transfers must be done using the Cancellations and Substitutions Form: https://forms.gle/J22hGcMTKcc9hpTAA. Telephone or email cancellations are not accepted.
